decision.action: Obtain one bounded pair of private images of the empty conversation's central UI, before and after opening the existing attachment control. Do not extend the role-selector search again.
decision.reason: The reported control state changes are established within the supplied observations, but no popup identity or actionable upload entry was observed. A rendered-image observation can address that gap without presuming another DOM role or implementing another menu classifier.

existingWorkBasis.supportedPoint: Playwright documents element screenshots and screenshot clipping. These are existing observation mechanisms rather than a reason to invent another semantic-menu detector.
existingWorkBasis.localCapabilityLimit: Public documentation does not establish the installed restricted client's available methods. Its actual contract controls.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256 and bind admission to those values and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: Stop controlled work if admission is unavailable, malformed, denied, expired, or mismatched.

captureCapabilityGate.requiredEvidence: Identify the installed contract's exact screenshot method, supported arguments, byte-return behavior, and coordinate system. Preserve only the relevant documentation excerpt and its source hash.

methodSelectionOrder.method: A documented direct clipped screenshot of the fixed central region.
A documented viewport-only screenshot returning bytes privately, followed immediately by deterministic in-memory cropping with existing local tooling.

viewportFallbackConditions: The screenshot operation returns bytes without automatically displaying an uncropped image to the worker or posting it to another surface.
Only the cropped central-region image is retained or returned.
The uncropped viewport bytes are not written to disk, logged, interpreted, or included in an artifact.
Cropping is available through existing local tooling without installing a dependency.
The operation does not capture browser chrome, the desktop, another window, or the full scrollable page.
captureCapabilityGate.ifNeitherMethodIsSupported: Return SUPPORTED_PRIVATE_REGION_CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE before any opening click. Include the relevant installed-contract excerpt; do not guess a method or bypass restrictions.

privacyScope.limitedSupersession: The preceding diagnostic's zero-visual-capture restriction is superseded only for these two central-region images. The private byte-returning viewport fallback is authorized only under captureCapabilityGate.
privacyScope.allowedImageContent: The empty conversation's central application region and the rendered interface overlapping that region after the single task-owned opening action.
privacyScope.incidentalVisibleUiMetadata: Incidental names or titles rendered inside this bounded region may be preserved in the private image for Project Manager review only. Do not transcribe, classify, search, or act on them.
excludedFromRetainedImages: Existing conversation bodies or document contents.
privacyScope.unexpectedSubstantiveContent: Stop further capture if known substantive content enters the target region. Preserve an operational incident record without copying that content into the return.

fixedCaptureRegion.derivation: Using structural geometry only, identify the unique main landmark containing the verified empty composer. Intersect that landmark's rectangle with the current viewport and exclude any overlapping history-sidebar or account-panel region before capture.
fixedCaptureRegion.freezeTiming: Freeze the rectangle and coordinate conversion before the opening action. Use exactly the same rectangle for both images.
requirements: The intended task tab, authorized account and profile are established.
Current message count, attachment count, and composer-content length are all observed as zero.
The main landmark and composer control are unambiguous.
The complete attachment-navigation control lies inside the fixed region.
The region excludes browser chrome, sidebar history, and account panels.
The screenshot coordinate mapping is documented and reproducible without guessing.
fixedCaptureRegion.ifRegionCannotBeEstablished: Return PRIVATE_CAPTURE_REGION_UNRESOLVED without a screenshot or opening click.
fixedCaptureRegion.ifPopupExtendsOutsideRegion: Preserve the partial view and its limitation. Do not enlarge the region or take an additional image.

liveSequence.action: After fresh admission, verify the bound private receipt, fixture manifest, installed contract, and safe empty task tab. Do not revisit historical conversations.
Establish the capture capability and fixed region. Observe the current attachment control as collapsed, unique, visible, and enabled. Do not interact with model controls.
Capture BASELINE_IMAGE once and preserve its cropped bytes, dimensions, region, timestamp, and hash.
Open the same currently verified Add files and more control once through the existing supported browser client.
Record the control's expanded state and capture OPEN_IMAGE once in the identical region. Do not require a role-menu element, look up a presumed upload label, or activate a popup entry.
Close only this diagnostic's positively identified in-page UI with one supported Escape action targeted to the same control, then record whether its collapsed state is verified.
Return the two private cropped images and their operational metadata through the fixed return method below. Stop without selecting a file or resuming a probe.

failureHandling.openingCallFailsOrIsAmbiguous: Do not repeat it. Preserve the error and use only the reserved targeted cleanup and state check when safe.
failureHandling.openCaptureFails: Preserve the baseline and error, perform only safe reserved cleanup, and return partial evidence.
failureHandling.noPopupVisibleInImage: Return the image without interpreting absence or changing the capture region.
failureHandling.unexpectedNativeChooser: Do not select a file. Stop and record the event; do not use native-picker automation.
failureHandling.cleanupNotVerified: Report the unresolved state without claiming the tab is ready for further work.
failureHandling.successfulCapture: Images are evidence for the Project Manager, not authorization for selector repair, upload, or probe execution.

returnTransport.imageSerialization: Include the exact retained cropped-image bytes as standard base64 strings inside the operational JSON object, together with byte count, MIME type, pixel dimensions, and SHA-256 for each image.
returnTransport.limitedTransportAuthorization: This permits only the two newly captured UI images in the existing JSON route. It does not authorize encoded transfer of any preserved archive, document, fixture, or historical response.
returnTransport.ifReturnWouldExceedLimit: Preserve the cropped files privately and return their metadata with UI_EVIDENCE_RETURN_SIZE_LIMIT. Do not split the return, upload files, or introduce another transport.
returnTransport.submissionAmbiguity: Check persisted destination metadata without resending. Preserve an unresolved return rather than repeating Send.

required: This directive's actual source identity and fresh runtime-admission receipt.
Actual repository HEAD and installed-client contract identity.
Verification results for the preceding private receipt and frozen fixture manifest.
The exact documented screenshot method and arguments used.
Frozen region, viewport geometry, coordinate conversion, and capture method.
Image byte counts, hashes, MIME types, dimensions, timestamps, and base64 payloads when within the fixed return limit.
Control states before opening, after opening, and after cleanup.
Exact operation counts and any errors or unavailable fields.
Confirmation that uncropped viewport bytes were not retained or displayed if the fallback was used.
Confirmation of zero file assignment, browser upload, model request, source-content inspection, account change, and paid operation.
Confirmed destination message identity or an explicit delivery blocker.
completionEvidence.returnFormat: One syntactically valid JSON object generated by the existing serializer. No Markdown escaping, raw page text, worker-authored visual interpretation, or substantive findings.

repositoryBoundary.permittedChanges: Only minimal capture-record serialization, deterministic crop or encoding tests if needed, this directive, and a redacted operational checkpoint.
repositoryBoundary.verification: Run applicable checks for changed code. Do not rerun unchanged verification merely to repeat an earlier result, and do not equate tests with live capture success.
repositoryBoundary.githubPersistence: Preserve reusable non-sensitive implementation and tests under existing conventions. Keep image bytes, detailed receipts, browser identifiers, and private paths outside public Git.

prohibitedActions: Repeat or broaden the role-container census.
Treat this image observation as a third P01 setup attempt.
Open an upload entry, register a chooser waiter, assign a file, or submit a probe.
Interact with model controls or require model-label verification for this no-inference observation.
Use forced clicks, injected events, application-state inspection, direct CDP, or undocumented endpoints.
Change permissions, accounts, profiles, global settings, browser backend, or installed dependencies.
Inspect or interpret image contents as the worker, run OCR, or follow visible document references.
Capture the desktop, browser chrome, or the full scrollable page.
Retain or disclose an uncropped viewport image.
Alter original fixtures, historical evidence, or recorded attempt counts.
Upload or repackage the previously delivered archive.
Publish private images or ask the owner to relay operational material.
stopConditions: Admission, source identity, installed contract, or private-region verification fails.
No supported privacy-preserving capture method exists.
A required operation fails, is denied, or remains ambiguous.
Execution would require broader access or an unsupported method.
A capture or submission ceiling is reached.
The bounded visual evidence or exact blocker has been returned.
